units.source_text: 岁月如流，但皇上思念已故桐壶更衣，无时或已。

en.t: The years flowed by like water, but the Emperor never ceased thinking of the late Kiritsubo Consort.

units.source_text: 有时为消愁解闷，也召见一些闻名的美人。

en.t: At times, to ease his sorrow and distract himself, he also summoned some celebrated beauties.

units.source_text: 然而都不中意，觉得像桐壶更衣那样的人，世间真不易再得。

en.t: Yet none pleased him, and he felt that someone like the Kiritsubo Consort was truly hard to find again in this world.

units.source_text: 他就从此疏远女人，一概无心顾问了。

en.t: From then on he kept women at a distance and had no heart to attend to any of them.

units.source_text: 一天，有一个侍候皇上的典侍，说起先帝[\[24\]](#part1330.html#m24)的第四皇女，容貌姣好，声望高贵；

en.t: One day, a Naishi who served the Emperor spoke of the former Emperor's fourth princess, saying that she was beautiful in appearance and noble in reputation;

units.source_text: 母后钟爱之深，世无其例。

en.t: the depth of her mother's love for her was without equal in the world.

units.source_text: 这典侍曾经侍候先帝，对母后也很亲近，时常出入宫邸，眼见这四公主长大成人；

en.t: This Naishi had once served the former Emperor and was also close to the Empress Mother, often going in and out of the palace residence and watching the fourth princess grow to adulthood;

units.source_text: 现在也常隐约窥见容姿。

en.t: even now she would often catch a faint glimpse of the princess's figure and bearing.

units.source_text: 这典侍奏道：“妾身入宫侍奉，已历三代，终未见与桐壶娘娘相似之人。

en.t: The Naishi reported, "Since entering the palace to serve, I have passed through three reigns, yet I have never seen anyone who resembled Lady Kiritsubo.

units.source_text: 惟有此四公主成长以来，酷肖桐壶娘娘，真乃倾国倾城之貌也。”

en.t: Only this fourth princess, since she has grown up, looks strikingly like Lady Kiritsubo; hers is truly a beauty that could overthrow a kingdom."

units.source_text: 皇上闻言，想道：“莫非真有其人？”

en.t: Hearing this, the Emperor thought, "Can there truly be such a person?"

units.source_text: 未免留情，便卑辞厚礼，劝请四公主入宫。

en.t: Unable to keep his feelings from stirring, he used humble words and generous courtesy to invite the fourth princess into the palace.
